hints.title: Convert Integer to Hexadecimal
hints.text: Parse the input string into a 64-bit integer and obtain its uppercase hexadecimal representation.

hints.title: Validate Allowed Letter Set
hints.text: Characters 2 through 9 are forbidden in hexspeak; only A through F, 0, and 1 are permitted.

hints.title: Substitute Digits 1 and 0
hints.text: Replace every digit 1 with uppercase I and every digit 0 with uppercase O; return the error string if invalid.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: value of parsed integer num
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual string division without 64-bit precision can overflow 32-bit limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Standard base conversion processes bits in logarithmic time and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle large numbers up to 10^12 accurately and check forbidden digits.
complexity.notes: Input string can represent values up to 10^12, requiring 64-bit integers.
